hello: Beit Maccabi! Fancy a game of handball? I'm always one player short.
first: Arrows to run, {k:Space} to pass, {k:Enter} to shoot. The yellow marker on the goal shows where the ball goes.
In defence {k:Q} puts you on the player nearest the ball. Stick to the man with the ball and steal it.
And the blue area belongs to the keeper. That line is not a suggestion.
go: Two and a half minutes. I'm blowing the whistle.
best: {score} goals! A new record. That's going on the board by the door.

about: A sports hall. Handball, basketball, and every evening somebody's training here.
bye: Go on. I'm here till the lights go off.

hb1_home.title: City league: home game 1

obj.play: Beat the Kiryat Ganim Hedgehogs at Beit Maccabi

offer: You're Malul? From the skate park? They say you've got quick hands.
Perfect. A drummer is a keeper who doesn't know it yet. I'm a player short for the city league.
Rishonim Stars. Three home games, a semi-final and a final. First up, the Kiryat Ganim Hedgehogs.
I'm Yoni, the captain. Don't worry, I started as a drummer too. On my school desk.
pre: Arrows to run, {k:Space} to pass, {k:Enter} to shoot. The yellow marker on the goal shows where the ball goes.
And keep out of the blue area. You can shoot over it, not step in it.
won: First win! The Hedgehogs are going back to Kiryat Ganim with their heads down.
They're hedgehogs. That's how they always walk.
See? I told you, quick hands.

hb1_home.fail: We lost. Ilan is waiting for a rematch
hb1_home.cheer: We beat the Kiryat Ganim Hedgehogs!

hb2_home.title: City league: home game 2

obj.play: Beat the Neve Hof Dolphins at Beit Maccabi

offer: Second home game: the Neve Hof Dolphins. They come straight from the sea, wet and slippery.
They keep a towel on the bench, too. It doesn't help them.
pre: They pass fast. Stand between the passer and the catcher and cut it off. {k:Q} puts you on the nearest player.
won: Two out of two. One more win and we're in the semi-final.
The Dolphins want a rematch at the beach. I told them we're an indoor team.

hb2_home.cheer: We beat the Neve Hof Dolphins!

hb3_home.title: City league: home game 3

obj.play: Beat the Ramat Eliyahu Eagles at Beit Maccabi

offer: Last home game: the Ramat Eliyahu Eagles. They're tall, and their keeper sees everything from up there.
Shoot for the corners. Eagles don't like corners.
The tall one with number 21? He's the keeper's brother. Neither of them likes corners.
pre: Their keeper is quick. Wait for the marker to reach the edge of the goal, then shoot.
won: Three out of three! We're in the semi-final.
I need to tell the band I'll be late for rehearsal.
Tell them to bring drums to the stands.
I'm bringing my sister with the big drum.

hb4_semi.title: City league: the semi-final

obj.play: Beat the Neot Eshelim Foxes in the semi-final

offer: Semi-final. The Neot Eshelim Foxes. They're sly: they look like they're passing, then they shoot.
I can look like I'm doing something too.
You're a drummer. You can't look like you're being quiet.
I'll mark their captain. You mark everybody else.
pre: In defence, stick to the man with the ball. Stay close long enough and you'll steal it.
won: The final! The Rishonim Stars are in the final!
The Nahalat Yehuda Lions. Nobody has beaten them in three seasons.

hb5_final.title: City league: the final

obj.play: Beat the Nahalat Yehuda Lions in the final

offer: This is the final. The Nahalat Yehuda Lions. Three seasons unbeaten.
I won't tell you it doesn't matter. It's all that matters.
You're really good at calming people down.
The whole neighbourhood is in the stands. Even the Hedgehogs from Kiryat Ganim came.
pre: A draw when time runs out means golden goal: whoever scores first takes the cup. Now go.
won: Champions! The Rishonim Stars are city champions!
Now you're a drummer with a cup. Come and play whenever you like, the door's open.
I'm calling my mum. She won't believe it.
